summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY with hands on experience building CNN and Vision Transformer based detection systems and pairing them with sensor driven electro mechanical control. Fine tuned a vision transformer for structured extraction, deployed YOLO based detection on embedded hardware for real time tracking and grasping, and owns end to end mechanical design and CAD work including fixtures, PCB layouts, and assemblies for physical robotics systems.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a full metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack detection using custom image processing, wavelet denoising, and depth estimation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine tuned DONUT, an OCR free vision transformer, on a custom dataset for structured field extraction, improving validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture recognition device integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and Bluetooth to translate hand motion into control commands via Python.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25 member robotics team across national level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision guided robotic pick and place system integrating TensorRT optimized YOLO detection (5.2x speedup) with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures across the detection and control pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at approximately 11.5s end to end latency.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending real time control commands to an STM32 microcontroller over UART with integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing.

projects.name: ABB RobotStudio Automation Simulation
bullets: Designed and simulated a full ABB RobotStudio workcell for an end to end press to packing assembly pipeline, including CAD modeled fixtures and RAPID control logic.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving in CARLA
bullets: Trained YOLO11n (mAP50 approximately 0.85) on an automated data generation pipeline of about 5,000 frames; validated with zero collisions across multiple simulated laps.

awards: 1st Prize, Poster Presentation — 2D and 3D Image Mosaicing of Microscopic Images, F.C.R.I.T. (2024)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
